diagnosis: StarNet already has every piece it needs. The mess is that most jobs have 3 to 15 doors that land in different places and use different words. Finished work shows up in five places, yet a new user's first result appears in none of the MY WORK tabs. The two NEEDS YOU lists disagree, and help text and error buttons point at doors that are hidden or wrong. The fix is one front door per job, one word per thing, a few better defaults, and a true one-liner wherever people get stuck. Nothing gets removed.

plain.P31: The setup screens stop contradicting themselves: one numbering, 'three setup questions' everywhere, pace hints inside the choices, and the nav coach waits until the awakening ends. Every interview question stays.
plain.P10: CONNECT and RECRUIT show in the dock from minute one. Today they're hidden until earned, while the help already tells people to click them. AUTOMATE and STEP-IN still grow in.
plain.P03: Every model, key or credit error gets one button, OPEN AI & MODELS, that scrolls to that provider's card. SIGN IN and RECONNECT actually start sign-in, and billing errors name the provider.
plain.P08: The create screen offers the same three access answers as everywhere else (CHECK WITH ME / LET IT WORK / FULL POWER), and each writes what it says. The approval card's 'Full access' becomes 'Never ask', because that is all it changes.
plain.P01: NEEDS YOU on the rail and in NOTIFICATIONS become one list with one count. It also catches builds, quest confirmations, goal-loop reviews and STEP-IN, which today wait unseen in other windows.
plain.P11: MY WORK opens on DELIVERABLES the first time instead of an empty TASKS board, and the board says what it is for.
plain.P30: Help, glossary and the agents' own manual name the real screens. Example: errors say 'check CONNECT' while keys live in SETTINGS › AI & MODELS.
plain.P25: Fewer empty sessions. A starter idea fills the chat you're in when it's blank, and hiring an agent doesn't make an empty session until you message it.
plain.P26: The COMMS title says which conversation you're in: 'COMMS · <session name>'. It's a name, not run-state, so the header law still holds.
plain.P02: Approval rows in NEEDS YOU get a Review button. Approval cards state the real auto-deny time, and the second ask for the same tool teaches 'Always'.
plain.P04: AI & MODELS gets one key box per provider: the duplicate API KEYS add row and the second CUSTOM form go, and saved keys keep update/remove. Plain names: FALLBACK MODELS, SPARE KEYS, ENDPOINT URL.
plain.P09: Autonomy copy says what will happen ('While you're away I'll do up to 3 small jobs a day'), not what unlocks. SANDBOX becomes LOCAL ONLY, and the BUILD rung becomes SMALL JOBS.
plain.P05: 'Where do I paste my key?' gets one answer per kind of key. Settings is for AI models; keys for Gmail, Notion and other services get one door to CONNECT › SAVED API CONNECTIONS.
plain.P16: Schedules follow one rule for whether saving turns scheduling on, in both forms. The status line tells the truth, ON/OFF reads the same everywhere, and the schedule form can run a workflow.
plain.P15: A workflow's page shows how it starts ('STARTS: by hand · every day 9:00') with a MAKE IT AUTOMATIC key into the existing editor. LAST JOBS also lists scheduled and channel runs (small backend part).
plain.P14: OUTBOX and WORKFLOWS stop promising a review click that doesn't work. Results point to DELIVERABLES › TO REVIEW, and the stale OUTBOX quest is retired.
plain.P12: TO REVIEW says what it holds, and 'CLEAR ALL' becomes 'MARK ALL REVIEWED'. It never deleted anything.
plain.P22: RECRUIT speaks one language: 'RECRUIT <NAME>' for a new agent vs 'RE-SPEC <AGENT> INSTEAD', so you know whether you're getting a new agent. Six verbs become one.
plain.P20: The DOSSIER key is always on each crew row. Today it turns hover-only once you have a second agent.
plain.P17: Both workflow editors use the same words for the same buttons (SEND A JOB, DELIVERED, SEND IT AGAIN…), and a real paid job is never labelled 'test' or 'sample'.
plain.P18: SET IT UP FOR ME can pick from every ready-made line instead of only 4, and onboarding's 'BUILD MODE › Presets' path becomes real. Conveyors opens on your goal's line and ANY JOB, with the other shelves folded.
plain.P06: Nudging PACE or REACH no longer secretly restarts automation you stopped, and anything that does lift a stop says 'Automation resumed'.
plain.P27: Queued-message and group-stop buttons say what they do: 'Stop every agent in this chat' and 'sends after this run · /steer changes the running task'.
plain.P24: DELIVERABLES file rows get the same open-folder and copy-path keys COMMS already has. That answers 'where did my file go?'.
plain.P13: The DELIVERABLES toolbar folds refresh and cleanup into MORE and keeps the filters. Cleanup is renamed to say what it deletes.
plain.P21: The agent dossier says where each per-agent setting really lives and which settings apply to every agent. VOICE and SKILLS rows there are your call.
plain.P23: Instruction fields say who follows them: 'only NOVA follows these' vs 'every agent follows these'.
plain.P19: Automation slash commands (/loop, /goal, /routine, /away) answer with a door into the right AUTOMATE tab.
plain.P29: 'Goal loop' means one thing. /goal says 'goal for this session' and links to GOAL LOOPS for lasting ones. QUESTS tabs match the other tab strips.
plain.P28: QUESTS › Progress shows each number once under a true name: the duplicate meter goes, STATION XP, MILESTONES.
plain.P33: Starter-room machines show a nameplate on hover. You pick: hover only, or a click that opens what the machine is.
